description: The core tool. Validates a ComputeRequest (kind plus the per-kind fields) and runs the engine, returning the full ComputeResult: a horary judgment, transit aspects + annual profection, a natal/electional chart, optional relocation, and (when `journal` is supplied) the auto-logged entry id.

journal.description: Optional auto-logging: when present, the compute appends a journal entry (the engine-derived fields plus this question) and returns the new entry id.

kind.description: Chart kind. Drives which other fields are required.

location.description: Required for "electional": the place to cast each candidate chart for.

moment.description: The chart's own moment. Required for natal/transit/horary; for "transit" use now.

datetimeLocal.description: Local civil datetime, ISO without offset, e.g. "1990-05-21T14:30:00".

natal.description: Required only for kind "transit": the natal chart.

datetimeLocal.description: Local civil datetime, ISO without offset, e.g. "1990-05-21T14:30:00".

querentHouse.description: Horary only. Radix house (1..12) the QUERENT's significator is read from (default 1, the asker). Set to TURN THE CHART for a third-party question: the querent house becomes the radix house of the person the matter is about (e.g. 7 for a partner), and quesitedHouse becomes their concern's DERIVED radix house.

quesitedHouse.description: House of the matter (2..12). Required for horary; reused by electional.

relocation.description: Optional: recast the chart's houses/angles for another place (same moment).

stepMinutes.description: Required for "electional": scan interval in minutes (e.g. 15).

window.description: Required for "electional": local-time window to scan (ISO without offset).

name: compute
title: Compute a chart judgment
